Issue: 2010 file has a shorter layout (53 vs 66 columns) and fewer industries reporting
Fix: Excluded 2010; analysis covers 2011-2023

Issue: Header row is row 4; rows 1-3 are titles
Fix: Read with header on row 4

Issue: Main sheet renamed in 2018
Fix: Selected sheet by prefix "Direct"

Issue: Column names have trailing spaces
Fix: Trimmed all column names

Issue: Oil & gas production, gathering, transmission pipeline and distribution methane are in separate sheets, not in Direct Emitters
Fix: Loaded the 4 sheets separately and appended with a Segment column

Issue: Gathering & Boosting and Transmission Pipelines only reported from 2016
Fix: Kept as is; flag the 2016 break on trend charts

Issue: Gases stored as wide columns, most cells blank or zero
Fix: Unpivoted to one row per facility-year-gas; dropped blank and zero values

Issue: Negative emission values
Fix: Checked; kept as reported

Issue: Basin stored as "code - name" in one field
Fix: Split into Basin_Code and Basin_Name

Issue: All values are CO2e using IPCC AR4 GWPs (CH4 = 25)
Fix: Back-calculated tonnes of gas and added AR5, AR6-100 and AR6-20 CO2e columns

Issue: HFC, PFC and other F-gas columns are mixtures of many gases, so a single GWP cannot be applied
Fix: Kept AR4 CO2e in all GWP columns; GWP_Converted = FALSE

Issue: Same facility appears under different names in different years
Example: "3M CORDOVA" vs "3M Chemical Operations' Cordova Facility"
Fix: Keyed everything on Facility Id; Dim_Facility uses the latest reported name

Issue: EPA typo in a sector label
Example: "Import and Export of Equipment Containing Fluorintaed GHGs"
Fix: Corrected to "Fluorinated"

Issue: Industry sector field holds several values in one cell
Fix: Created Bridge_Facility_Sector (one row per facility-sector) and a Primary_Sector column

Issue: Empty rows in the parent file
Fix: Dropped

Issue: Same parent company spelled many ways
Fix: Normalised (upper case, punctuation, legal suffixes, spaces) to a match key: 7,236 keys; then fuzzy-merged 117 near-identical keys (ratio >= 95, same first 5 letters; numbered or lettered entities and known different names kept apart): 7,119 parents. Each group shows its most common spelling. Merges listed in Parent_Fuzzy_Merges for review

Issue: Missing ownership percentage
Fix: Assumed 100% ownership

Issue: Facilities with several owners, or owner shares summing above 100%
Fix: Kept shares as reported; added Share_Sum so dashboards can normalise

Issue: Aggregate partner rows mixed with country rows (double counting risk)
Fix: Removed from the fact table; kept as Eurostat_Totals for reconciliation

Issue: Value and quantity stored as separate rows (long indicator column)
Fix: Pivoted to Value_EUR and Quantity_t columns; converted 100 kg to tonnes

Issue: Partner shown only as 2-letter codes, including Eurostat-only codes
Fix: Added Partner_Name and an EU-27 flag (intra- vs extra-EU)

Issue: HFC codes changed in 2022 (HS2022): 290341-290349 replace part of 290339
Fix: Kept both; use Product_Group "F-gases (HFCs)" for a continuous time series

Issue: The page ends with a terminal-total section (all destinations) that follows the last country block and would be double counted under it
Example: "Cameron, LA" total rows after "To United Kingdom"
Fix: Moved to Terminal_Totals using the EIA series code (-z00 = all destinations); used to reconcile

Issue: Web table mixes country subtotals and terminal rows
Fix: Parsed terminal rows under each destination; dropped subtotal rows; blanks and "--" treated as no data

Issue: Volumes in million cubic feet
Fix: Added Volume_bcm (1 MMcf = 0.0283168 million m3)

Issue: Wide layout: one column per series (76 series), years as rows, blanks before a route existed
Fix: Unpivoted to one row per year-series; dropped blanks (no data), kept reported zeros

Issue: Prices are on a separate sheet (Data 2) with matching series codes ending 3 instead of 2
Rows_Affected: 706 of 1,045 volume rows got a price
Fix: Joined price to volume on the series stem; price blank where EIA withholds it

Issue: Total, mode subtotal and country rows are mixed in one table (double counting risk)
Example: "U.S. Natural Gas Exports" + "Pipeline Exports to Canada"
Fix: Added Mode and Is_Total_Row; sum country rows within one Mode only

Dataset: EIA LNG by point of exit (xls)
Issue: Country subtotals and the U.S. total sit next to terminal series
Example: "Liquefied U.S. Natural Gas Exports to France"
Fix: Kept only terminal series; subtotals used to reconcile

Dataset: EIA LNG by point of exit (xls)
Issue: Inconsistent series names: word order, double spaces, "Korea" vs "South Korea", "West Palm Beach, Florida" vs "FL"
Example: "Sabine Pass, LA Exports to Korea Liquefied Natural Gas"
Fix: Parsed Terminal and Destination with one pattern, collapsed spaces, standardised country and state names

Dataset: EIA LNG by point of exit (xls)
Issue: EIA terminal totals are slightly higher than the sum of their destinations in a few years (destination not reported by EIA)
Example: Cameron, LA 2020: 382,405 total vs 378,711 by destination
Rows_Affected: 3 terminal-years (2020 Cameron and Cove Point, 2024 Cove Point; 7,713 MMcf in all)
Fix: Kept as published; use LNG_Terminal_Totals for terminal totals and Fact_LNG_Exports_Terminal for destination splits

Dataset: EIA LNG by point of exit (xls)
Issue: Earlier table was parsed from the EIA web page (2020-2025 only)
Fix: Replaced with the official xls series (1996-2025, 2,136 rows); 2020-2025 yearly totals matched the web-page parse exactly (checked 2026-10-04)

Issue: U.S. total, "Other States" subtotal, state totals and onshore/offshore components are mixed (double counting risk)
Fix: Added Level (U.S. total / Other States total / State or federal offshore area / Component); sum only "State or federal offshore area" rows

Issue: Small states only appear in a second sheet ("Other States")
Fix: Appended both sheets; Other_States_Group flags them

Issue: 2025: EIA publishes the Other States subtotal but not yet the small states inside it
Fix: For 2025 add the "Other States total" row to the state rows to reach the U.S. total

Issue: Series start in different years (U.S. from 1900, some states from 1967); blanks before a series starts
Fix: Dropped blanks; filter Year >= 2011 to align with EPA data

Issue: File is semicolon-separated, not comma-separated
Fix: Read with ; delimiter

Issue: Aggregates (World, European Union) sit in the same column as countries
Fix: Moved to IEA_Methane_Totals; checked World = sum of all other regions and EU = sum of its 10 countries + 2 "Rest of EU" groups (both match exactly)

Issue: Some regions are IEA model groups, not countries
Fix: Added Region_Type (Country / IEA residual group); EU27 flag includes the two "Rest of European Union" groups

Issue: Satellite-detected large emitter events are a separate "Hydrocarbon" category, not oil or gas
Fix: Added Is_Satellite flag so dashboards can show inventory-based and satellite-detected emissions separately

Issue: Most cells are zero (source not present in that country)
Fix: Dropped zero rows (same rule as EPA emissions)

Issue: Values are tonnes of methane, not CO2e (unlike EPA, which reports AR4 CO2e)
Fix: Added AR5, AR6-100 and AR6-20 CO2e columns with the same GWPs as Dim_Gas so IEA and EPA can be compared

Issue: Notes column holds the full citation list (about 1,200 characters per row)
Fix: Kept the first sentence in Notes_Short for display; full notes stay in the raw file

Issue: Downloaded from Envirofacts as one file per year, all named "CSV.csv"
Fix: Renamed by reporting year (epa_subpart_w_emissions_by_source_YYYY.csv) and appended; years 2015-2023

Issue: Two columns are completely empty
Fix: Dropped

Issue: Every facility gets a row for all 22 source categories, even ones that do not apply to its segment, so most rows are blank or zero
Example: Pipeline facility with a "Well Testing" row
Fix: Dropped rows where CO2, CH4 and N2O are all blank or zero

Issue: EPA renamed source categories between 2015 and 2018 (e.g. "Production Storage Tanks" became "Atmospheric Storage Tanks"; 2015 completions are not split by hydraulic fracturing)
Fix: Mapped legacy names to the current category; original names listed in Map_Source_Category_Legacy. Checked that no facility-year reports under both names

Issue: Source category and segment names carry the 40 CFR 98 citation in brackets; one category name is 190 characters long
Example: "Combustion Equipment at Onshore Petroleum and Natural Gas Production Facilities, ... [98.236(z)"
Fix: Moved citations to *_Citation columns; shortened the combustion category to "Combustion Equipment"

Issue: Segment names differ from the yearly summary files
Example: "Onshore petroleum and natural gas gathering and boosting" vs "Gathering & Boosting"
Fix: Added a short Segment name matching Fact_Emissions so both tables filter the same way

Issue: No emission type (vented, fugitive, flared, combustion) in the data
Fix: Added Emission_Type from the source category (analyst mapping, matches IEA Methane Tracker "Reason" where possible)

Issue: Basin only reported for basin-based segments (production, gathering and boosting); blank elsewhere
Fix: Split "code - name" into Basin_Code and Basin_Name; left blank where the segment has no basin

Issue: Values are metric tonnes of each gas, not CO2e (the yearly summary files use AR4 CO2e)
Rows_Affected: 204,968 rows after unpivot (90,889 blank/zero gas cells dropped)
Fix: Checked against the summary sheets: facility CH4 totals match (ratio 1.00) for 99.9% (2015-2023) of onshore production, gathering, transmission pipeline and distribution facility-years. Unpivoted to one row per gas and added AR4, AR5, AR6-100 and AR6-20 CO2e with the Dim_Gas GWPs

Issue: Wide text columns repeat on every row (37 MB file)
Fix: Moved category citation and emission type to Dim_Source_Category, legacy names to Map_Source_Category_Legacy; basin name is in Fact_Emissions/Dim_Facility via Basin_Code

Issue: Gathering & Boosting and Transmission Pipelines segments only report from 2016, so 2015 totals are not comparable
Fix: Kept 2015; use 2016-2023 for trends and intensity models, or compare like-for-like segments only

Issue: Units were only implied by column names and differed between tables (Tonnes_Gas, CO2e_AR4_t, CH4_kt, Volume_MMcf, Value_EUR)
Example: CH4_kt in IEA vs CO2e_AR4_t in EPA
Fix: One standard: t (mass of gas), tCO2e (emissions), bcm (gas volume), USD (money; EUR kept alongside), USD/MMBtu (gas price), 0-1 (shares). Unit is now the column suffix, e.g. CO2e_AR5_tCO2e, Volume_bcm, Value_USD

Issue: Column names mixed spaces, brackets and underscores
Fix: Renamed to Snake_Case (Facility_Id, Industry_Type_Sectors, Year)

Issue: For HFC, PFC and other mixtures the "tonnes of gas" column held AR4 CO2e, not tonnes (EPA reports mixtures only as CO2e)
Fix: Gas_t left blank for mixtures so it is never summed as tonnes; their CO2e columns are unchanged (AR4)

Issue: Ownership given twice, as a percent (0-100) and as a share (0-1)
Fix: Kept Ownership_Share (0-1) only; renamed Share_Sum to Ownership_Share_Sum

Issue: EU trade values are in EUR while EIA prices are in USD, so the two could not be compared
Fix: Added Value_USD using the Eurostat annual average EUR/USD rate for each year (ert_bil_eur_a; Dim_FX_EUR_USD) and Unit_Value_USD_per_t; EUR kept for EU context

Issue: Eurostat_Totals still had raw units and names (100 kg, TIME_PERIOD)
Fix: Converted to Quantity_t, Value_EUR, Value_USD; renamed to Year, Aggregate, HS6

Issue: Gas volumes were in million cubic feet (EIA) while EU data and the brief use bcm
Fix: Volume_bcm only (1 MMcf = 0.0000283168 bcm, 9 decimals so small terminals keep precision); MMcf stays in the raw files

Issue: Gas export prices were in USD per thousand cubic feet
Fix: Converted to Price_USD_per_MMBtu (the US benchmark unit) using 1.036 MMBtu per Mcf (EIA average heat content); approximate by about 1% because heat content varies a little by year

Issue: IEA reports thousand tonnes (kt) while EPA reports tonnes
Fix: Converted to CH4_t and CO2e_*_tCO2e (x 1,000)

Issue: Overview file stacks 12 different EPA tables (AA.1 to AA.10) in one sheet, each using different columns
Example: Table AA.1.i production, AA.1.ii sub-basins, AA.10.i pipeline miles
Fix: Kept the two onshore production tables needed for methane intensity (AA.1.i and AA.1.ii); other segments stay in Raw Data

Issue: One facility reported gas sales about 1,000 times too high, so 2019 US production looked double the other years
Example: Felix Energy Holdings II LLC (1013342), 2019: 25.3 billion Mscf = 25 Tcf, more than half of all US output; its oil (15.8 million bbl) points to about 25 Bcf
Fix: Divided by 1,000 (treated as reported in scf instead of Mscf); flagged Gas_Value_Corrected = TRUE

Issue: Production in EPA units (gas in thousand standard cubic feet, oil in barrels)
Fix: Gas converted to Gas_Sales_bcm (1 Mscf = 0.0000000283168 bcm); oil kept in barrels (Oil_Sales_bbl), the standard oil unit

Issue: Exact duplicate sub-basin rows
Example: 0 identical rows (facility, year, sub-basin and all values the same)
Fix: Dropped

Issue: Formation type written in mixed case
Fix: Standardised to sentence case (Shale gas, Oil, ...)

Issue: Some oil sub-basins have several rows that differ only in pressure, API gravity or gas-to-oil ratio; the well count is repeated on each row
Fix: One row per sub-basin: well counts take the largest value (not summed, which would double count); pressure-type values averaged

Issue: Sub-basin id packs basin, county, state and formation type into one text field
Fix: Split into Basin_Code, Sub_Basin_County, State, Sub_Basin_Formation_Type; original id kept as Sub_Basin_Id

Issue: Subpart W only covers onshore production facilities above the 25,000 tCO2e threshold, so it is not all US gas
Example: EPA share of EIA marketed production: 83% to 90% by year
Fix: Kept as reported; Recon_SubpartW_vs_EIA_Production shows the coverage each year. Use EPA production for facility intensity and EIA for national totals

Issue: File for United States arrived empty (1 byte)
Fix: Not needed: the World file has all 102 United States rows (102 rows); filter Country = United States

Issue: Two pairs of identical rows
Example: Region Other, Country Other, savings 0.01 kt
Fix: Kept: IEA groups small countries under "Other", so identical rows can be different countries

Issue: Savings in thousand tonnes of methane and cost per MMBtu of gas saved, which cannot be compared with EPA tonnes or carbon prices
Fix: Savings_CH4_t (x 1,000) and Savings_CO2e_AR5_tCO2e (GWP 28); Cost_USD_per_tCH4 = cost x 52.6 MMBtu per tonne of methane; Cost_USD_per_tCO2e_AR5 = that / GWP. IEA "MBtu" means million Btu. Negative cost = gas sales pay for the measure

Issue: IEA measures and EPA source categories use different names
Example: Vapour recovery units vs Atmospheric Storage Tanks
Fix: Map_Abatement_Source_Category links each measure to the Subpart W source it cuts (judgement; please review). Abandoned wells and Other have no EPA match

Issue: EPA data ends in the last reporting year; dashboard needs values to 2030
Fix: OLS linear 2016-2023 per segment + total, 90% prediction band on total, pledge path; script forecast_methane.py run 2026-10-05
